bookmark_tweet.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): private to the account and trivially reversible.

create_poll_tweet.rationale: Public publication that additionally solicits third-party engagement which cannot be undone.

delete_all_bookmarks.rationale: Bulk and irreversible by its own description; iterates destructively over the whole collection with no confirmation step.

delete_bookmark.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): removes one private, re-addable item.

delete_tweet.rationale: Permanently removes published content. Breaks threads, citations, and embeds beyond the account.

favorite_tweet.rationale: Likes are public and attributable — a published endorsement, not private state.

get_bookmarks.rationale: Pass-through (read): the account's own bookmarks. Private, but reading them is not publishing them.

get_highlights_tweets.rationale: Pass-through (read): highlighted tweets from a user timeline.

get_timeline.rationale: Pass-through (read): home timeline, For You view.

get_tweet_details.rationale: Pass-through (read): a single tweet's content and metrics.

get_user_by_id.rationale: Pass-through (read): public profile lookup by ID.

get_user_by_screen_name.rationale: Pass-through (read): public profile lookup by handle.

get_user_subscriptions.rationale: Pass-through (read): subscription list, proxied via following.

post_tweet.rationale: Publishes to the public record under the account's name. Cannot be recalled; a deletion is itself public.

unfavorite_tweet.rationale: Publicly visible withdrawal of an endorsement.

vote_on_poll.rationale: Pass-through (simulated): mocked upstream, so it has no real effect. If it is ever implemented for real that is upstream tool drift, which the snapshot hash surfaces.
